mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the core CPI inflation rate is below 2.0% year-over-year, the economy is in a low-inflation, low-rate environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the joint condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined as federal funds rate above 1.0%), the economy faces higher borrowing costs and reduced liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
